title: Touchscreen usability and screen layout
summary: Feedback on the G70 touchscreen centers on a split between attractive screen appearance and complaints about cluttered, complicated menus and setup.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the touchscreen's appearance and describe it as pleasing or easy to use.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on crowded icons, complicated menu navigation, confusing setup or pairing, slow or frustrating operation, and screen smudging.

undetermined.summary: One undetermined review mentions the display screen position as challenging in normal use, but the excerpt is too incomplete to assign a clearer sentiment.

limitations: All examples are from US G70 reviews, so the summary does not cover other models or countries.
The sample is small and sentiment-stratified, so it should not be treated as representative prevalence.
One undetermined excerpt is truncated or incomplete, which limits interpretation of the screen-position concern.
